boundary: Every supplied lab quote is included. Prior trial hypotheses are memory; only subsequent publicly activated rows may enter a forward comparison. Empty cells are unquoted, not zero-output routes.

hypothesis.failureCondition: Reject after the first 10 eligible paired observations if none meets the entry rule: post-gas edge of at least 30 bps, gas price at or below 30000000 wei, and two consecutive eligible observations meeting that rule. Passing this screen is not acceptance; retain the original control and require the seven-day, 1000-observation acceptance gate. Quote results alone do not establish fills, inclusion, or profit.
hypothesis.name: Hypothesis: WETH–CASHCAT–USDG triangle at 0.005 WETH
hypothesis.rationale: The graph contains this distinct WETH → CASHCAT → USDG → WETH route, using the 3000, 10000, and 10000 fee tiers. Hypothesis: a temporary price dislocation involving the CASHCAT–USDG pool could overcome the route’s fees and gas reserve at this exact size; it is worth testing only if fresh quotes satisfy the stated entry rule. No supplied training quote measures this route at this size, so its output and edge remain unknown.

result.boundary: Ten-observation prospective futility screen followed by longer forward collection for promising ideas. This is not seven-day acceptance. Signals assume known gas only, are not fills or complete profit, and do not authorize a policy change.
